rule_name: Customer ID must not be null

test_sql: customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM main.stg_customer GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
nik IS NOT NULL AND (length(nik) <> 16 OR NOT regexp_matches(nik, '^[0-9]{16}$'))
nik IS NOT NULL AND nik IN (SELECT nik FROM main.stg_customer WHERE nik IS NOT NULL GROUP BY nik HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

rule_name: Phone must follow approved Indonesian format
test_sql: phone IS NOT NULL AND NOT regexp_matches(phone, '^08[0-9]{8,13}$')
email IS NOT NULL AND NOT regexp_matches(lower(email), '^[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$')

rule_name: Birth date must not be future
test_sql: birth_date IS NOT NULL AND birth_date > CURRENT_DATE
